relation: simple-graph subcubicity: X14 x14_subcubic G := forall v, #|N(v)| <= 3 converts to GTBase.base.subcubic G; X114 x114_subcubic H := Delta H <= 3 equals GTBase.base.subcubic H by the unconditional finite-maximum bridge GTBase.base.subcubicP (bigmax_leqP), the empty graph included. An upper bound on simple-graph degrees, distinct from the multigraph incidence contracts mcubic/loopless_cubic (exactly three incident edges) and from exact regularity.
summary: Batch A, family A14 (simple-graph subcubic bound), on the private union ba8b7be (A13 004cf63 + reviewed C13 cdb9e10, with C11). GTBase.base.subcubic G := forall v : G, #|N(v)| <= 3 is the pointwise bound; subcubicP proves it equal to Delta G <= 3 for every graph (K_0 included: subcubic vacuously, with Delta 0). API: subcubic_K0, regular_subcubic, subcubic_Kn (n <= 3), not_subcubic_K5 and subcubic_diso. GTMisc X14.x14_subcubic converts; X114.x114_subcubic is a proved iff, not a conversion. The inline Delta G <= 3 hypotheses of Hamilton X5, Extremal D2chr and Chromatic U5 are statement text, not helpers, and stay unchanged. Multigraph incidence cubicity (A13 mcubic/loopless_cubic) and exact simple-graph regularity stay distinct.

Frozen verbatim at ba8b7be: the two sources, X102's chains x102_subdivided_multiclaw and x102_line_graph_of_subdivided_multiclaw, and the whole rows X14.subcubic_matching_lower_bound_statement, X114.subcubic_induced_subdivision_np_complete_statement and X102.bounded_tree_independence_forbidden_family_statement (forest, subcubic and at-most-one-branch-vertex multiclaw, complete bipartite and line-graph members, full biconditional, all unchanged). Each complete bridge reuses the earlier certificate: X14 and X102 by conversion, X114 after rewriting x114_subcubic_compat under the existential.
